content.text:
**Repaired finding submitted.**

The verifier's only unmet element — *"The cap is based on 12 months of fees."* — is now carried by determinate, directional operative language. Because this agreement has no "Fees" concept, the cap sentence now reads:

> "…will not exceed the sum of (a) the Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ and (b) the amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under Article 6 and Section 14.2, in each case during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim."

- **Determinacy:** both components are defined/expressly identified streams (Development Costs, 1.1.57; Article 6 Approval Payments; Section 14.2 termination amounts).
- **Direction stated:** SFJ's costs and PB's payments to SFJ are each named, so the measure is no longer ambiguous as to whose payments count.
- **Not illusory:** including SFJ's Development Costs keeps the twelve-month magnitude meaningful before any Approval Payment falls due, so SFJ's exposure to us is not capped at near zero.
- Everything else is unchanged: mutual cap, the four fallback carve-outs in one Excluded Claims sentence, the favourable mutual consequential-damages exclusion and the PB-payment carve-out retained, no preferred-level or boilerplate extras added.
